method.compute: CPU-only parsing on the existing training host
method.log_transfer: None; only aggregate numeric summaries were returned.
method.per_task_alignment: The logs contain scalar loss rows but no task-id field. Joint row task IDs were reconstructed from ordered log cadence (log_freq=100), the pinned exposure-matched sampler algorithm, Python 3.12 random.Random(seed=2001), and task_index row counts read from the registered Parquet dataset. This is code-derived alignment, not direct task-id telemetry.

interpretation.supported: Both registered runs show large decreases in logged training loss. Reconstructed late joint per-task loss summaries are similar across the four tasks, and task0 is not conspicuously higher than single task0 on this training metric.
interpretation.not_established: Training loss is not an environment-success metric. The joint log does not emit task IDs, so task alignment is reconstructed from the pinned sampler and data counts; no independent runtime batch trace was added. One seed pair cannot prove or exclude multi-task interference, and similar loss cannot rule out representation, state-distribution, or policy-generalization effects.
interpretation.gate: Evaluation remains single task0 14/20 paired plus 5/5 fixed init3 (pass), joint task0 10/20 plus 5/5 fixed init3 (fail unchanged 11/20 paired threshold).
interpretation.progression: Do not lower the threshold or start another task-count expansion. Fold02 and 8-task expansion remain locked.
